name: siren-uniform
description: Swaps in the older encoder siren_uniform.pt (2026-08-01, epoch 700, meta val_mse 0.00346), which was meta-trained before the GMM-query option existed and therefore used purely uniform query points. Its query fraction is set to 0.0 to match that training, exactly as baseline uses 0.5 to match siren_gmmq05.pt. Never evaluated downstream despite having the best meta-validation MSE of any checkpoint. Restore it with: git cat-file -p efa8cab:constrained_fm/functa_dataset/siren_best.pt > constrained_fm/functa_dataset/siren_uniform.pt   (sha256 abe5b220b8)
